verdict.rationale: Bulk retrieval or bulk operations are a fair question for a public register portal, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents single-query search (normal, extended and quick search by company name or EUID) and per-order publication submissions. There is no documented bulk download, batch query or multi-item operation, and the overload notes describe high traffic, not a bulk feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
